approval_note: Parent approved these append-only definitions before lower-ranked case grading on 2026-09-14.

predicates.label: founder or co-founder of
predicates.definition: Person or organization X founded or co-founded organization, institution, business, movement, or polity Y.
includes: explicit founder or co-founder
founded or established Y in the institutional-creation sense
historical founding
excludes: ownership or managerial office alone
merely joined or acquired an existing organization
discovery or finding an object
proposed founding without realization
ambiguous: an incomplete institution or polity argument
a creator or builder phrase without clear institutional founding
unclear who is the founder
predicates.notes: Founding is separate from holding an office or retaining ownership. The direction is founder to founded institution.

predicates.label: physically present in place
predicates.definition: Entity X is or was physically present in geographic place Y, temporarily or as a resident or located institution.
includes: explicit unqualified physical be-in or presence
a direct residence or physical location statement
a completed arrival, visit, or departure that establishes presence in Y
excludes: membership in an organization
participation or victory in a nongeographic event
political office or control alone
discussion, publication, or other abstract presence
a destination without evidence of realized movement or presence
ambiguous: place-versus-institution metonymy
an incomplete geographic argument
uncertain attachment or explicit hypothetical presence
predicates.notes: Physical presence is weaker than residence or headquarters. Those narrower predicates retain their existing definitions. Do not infer a geographic location from membership or event participation.

predicates.label: organization described by national affiliation
predicates.definition: Organization X is explicitly described as belonging to the national or country affiliation designated by Y.
includes: an explicit national adjective modifying the organization, such as a French company
a directly stated country-of-origin or national institutional affiliation
multiple explicitly named national affiliations
excludes: physical offices or temporary operations in a country alone
ownership by a person or organization of that nationality alone
a national adjective modifying an unrelated person or parent rather than X
a person's nationality
ambiguous: unclear national adjective attachment
a regional or city descriptor rather than a national affiliation
national origin versus current affiliation when the distinction is material
predicates.notes: Y can be a complete nationality designation such as French or British-Dutch; this predicate does not assert headquarters or legal incorporation. A nationality label used as the argument here differs from an incomplete institution name in an office predicate.

predicates.label: president of institution
predicates.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president office in organization, team, public body, or institution Y.
includes: explicit president office
a functional or departmental president role within Y
historical or former presidency
excludes: manager, director, chairman, head, or executive alone without a president title
ordinary employment or membership
candidate or nomination alone
ambiguous: president-elect or unresolved tenure without evidence of holding office
an incomplete institution or personal principal
unclear holder or title attachment
predicates.notes: This specific title is separate from president_or_manager_of and managerial_office_in. It does not require that the officeholder be the sole head of Y.

predicates.label: editor of publication
predicates.definition: Person X serves or served as an editor of, for, or at publication Y.
includes: explicit editor or editor-in-chief
section or departmental editor within a publication
explicitly editing publication Y
historical editorial office
excludes: publisher, director, owner, or author alone
ordinary writing or contribution without editorial role
merely being quoted or discussed in the publication
ambiguous: an incomplete publication argument
editor title attaching to someone other than X
editing a work versus holding the publication's editorial role when unclear
predicates.notes: Publisher-only and writer-only evidence do not establish this editorial role. A section editor is included without implying overall control of the publication.

predicates.label: reviewed artistic output of
predicates.definition: Person X explicitly reviews or reviewed artistic work or performance produced or performed by artist, ensemble, or producing institution Y.
includes: review of Y's performance, program, production, or artistic work
direct review of artist or ensemble Y in an artistic criticism context
historical reviews
excludes: a review merely taking place at venue Y
ordinary mention, attendance, or affiliation
an unrelated subject reviewed at a place owned by Y
authorship for a publication without reviewing Y's work
ambiguous: Y could denote the venue rather than the producer or performer
unclear reviewer or artistic-work attachment
predicates.notes: Inspect argument roles before assigning this predicate. A producing theater or ensemble can be Y; a venue alone is not automatically the artistic creator.

predicates.label: manager of institution
predicates.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified manager office in organization, team, business, or public institution Y.
includes: explicit manager or general manager
a functional or departmental managerial office within Y
historical managerial office
excludes: president, director, head, executive, or coach alone without a manager title
ordinary employment or membership
candidate or proposed appointment alone
ambiguous: a personal principal standing for an omitted institution or campaign
unclear manager or institutional attachment
appointment without established tenure
predicates.notes: This specific title is separate from president_or_manager_of and managerial_office_in. A sports manager qualifies; merely coaching does not prove the manager title.

predicates.label: known or named as
predicates.definition: Entity X is explicitly known, named, renamed, or referred to by alternative name Y for the same entity.
includes: explicit known-as or also-called identity
a stated alias or alternative name
historical renaming of the same entity
excludes: a named subsidiary or distinct entity
comparison or resemblance rather than identity
ordinary description without an alternative designation
ambiguous: unclear referent of the alternative name
an explicitly proposed new name without established use
name versus separate institution when unresolved
predicates.notes: The predicate concerns two names or designations of one referent. Do not infer identity from an ownership relationship.

predicates.label: has or had medical condition
predicates.definition: Person X, or an explicitly identified subset of population X, has or had medical condition Y.
includes: explicit having or suffering from Y
diagnosis of Y
death from or of Y establishing the condition
a stated affected subset of a named population
excludes: generic discussion or research about Y
treating another person with Y
a disease merely located in a place
a generic have phrase whose object is not a medical condition
ambiguous: unclear condition attachment or affected person
risk, possible diagnosis, or suspected condition without confirmation
a population mention that does not identify affected members
predicates.notes: This is annotation of textual support, not medical guidance. A population fact does not imply every member has the condition.

predicates.label: participated in sporting event
predicates.definition: Competitor or team X participated in sporting event or competition Y.
includes: actual played-in, competed-in, or appeared-in a sporting event
being in an event when competitive participation is clear
a completed win or title in the event, which entails participation
excludes: plans, hopes, or qualification without established participation
attendance as spectator
membership in a league without participation in the designated event
non-sporting events or geographic presence alone
ambiguous: future or proposed participation
event occurrence or participant role unclear
a governing body or location substituted for an unresolved event
predicates.notes: Participation does not require winning. Preserve defeated and winner_of as separate predicates where those meanings were declared.

predicates.label: met or encountered
predicates.definition: Person, group, institution, or sports team X actually met or encountered Y.
includes: explicit actual meet or meet-with encounter
a meeting between representatives clearly attributed to the named institutions
actual meeting of opposing sports teams
excludes: communication alone without an encounter
a proposed or scheduled meeting not established as occurring
physical confluence of rivers or geographic features
mere co-occurrence or comparison
ambiguous: future or planned meeting when occurrence is unresolved
meeting versus satisfying an abstract requirement
unclear representatives or participants
predicates.notes: The primary direction follows the extracted arguments, although an encounter is semantically mutual. Team meetings include competitive encounters but do not imply a result.

predicates.label: has coach
predicates.definition: Team or sporting organization X has or had person Y as an explicitly identified coach.
includes: explicit head coach, coach, or assistant coach office
historical coaching office
excludes: ordinary player or manager alone without a coach title
an opponent or commentator
proposed appointment alone
ambiguous: unclear title or team attachment
a coach-elect or proposed appointment without established tenure
predicates.notes: Inverse of coach_of. This does not assert that Y is the sole or current coach.

predicates.label: has or had wife
predicates.definition: Person X is or was married to woman Y identified as X's wife.
includes: explicit wife or spouse identified as wife
wife apposition or accompanied-by-wife attachment establishing the couple
historical or former wife
excludes: daughter or other relative
ordinary companion or accompaniment without a wife relationship
a fictional or proposed marriage unless actual marital status is stated
ambiguous: unclear whose wife Y is
wife versus other companion attachment unresolved
engagement without established marriage
predicates.notes: The ordered argument roles are person to wife; do not substitute generic kinship or companionship.

predicates.label: practices law in place
predicates.definition: Person X is explicitly described as a lawyer practicing or professionally based in geographic place Y.
includes: explicit lawyer-in place
a city or geographic nominal modifier of a lawyer establishing professional location
historical legal practice in the place
excludes: representing a client or institution alone
a law firm or personal client in the geographic argument slot
residence or travel alone without legal practice
ambiguous: public attorney office for a jurisdiction without evidence of practice location
geographic versus institutional meaning of Y unresolved
unclear attachment of the place to the lawyer
predicates.notes: Separate from lawyer_for, which concerns representation or professional institutional affiliation. A governmental jurisdiction as client or office does not automatically establish this geographic practice predicate.

predicates.label: location of organization or its office
predicates.definition: Geographic place X hosts the physical location, base, or office of organization Y.
includes: explicit organization location, headquarters, office, or base in X
a geographically identified office or division of Y located in X
historical physical organizational location
excludes: X is a corporate subsidiary or parent rather than a geographic place
national affiliation alone without physical location
ordinary travel, discussion, or an unrelated event in X
ambiguous: place versus institution metonymy unresolved
a geographic division name without clear physical location
unclear organization or location attachment
predicates.notes: This is the inverse direction of located_in. The presence of an office does not imply that all of Y is headquartered there; corporate ownership alone is not location.

predicates.label: died in place
predicates.definition: Person X, or an explicitly identified subset of population X, died in geographic place Y.
includes: explicit died-in or death-in location
being killed in Y establishing death there
historical death location
excludes: residence, birth, or ordinary presence alone
Y is the perpetrator or cause rather than location
discussion of deaths without the affected person or population
ambiguous: place versus institution unresolved
unclear death or geographic attachment
a population mention without identified affected members
predicates.notes: This describes location of death, not where X lived or who caused death. An affected subset does not imply every member died.

predicates.label: has member
predicates.definition: Organization, organized group, team, or institutional body X has or had entity Y as a member.
includes: explicit membership or being included as a group member
a clearly established office or athlete role that entails membership of the stated group
historical membership
excludes: corporate subsidiary ownership without membership in an explicitly identified group
a geographic area containing a place
ordinary accompaniment or a meeting
planned membership without established admission
ambiguous: generic include or join without group-membership context
unclear group versus geographic or corporate containment
proposed admission or unresolved member identity
predicates.notes: Inverse of member_of. A leader belongs to the stated group when local evidence establishes that institutional role; mere political support or family relation is insufficient.

predicates.label: acted jointly with
predicates.definition: Entity X explicitly acted jointly or cooperated with counterpart Y in a shared action.
includes: explicit cooperation or joint action
joining Y in a specified shared action
historical realized cooperation
excludes: joining an institution as a member
physical arrival, river confluence, or ordinary accompaniment
a generic relationship without a shared action
fighting against Y
ambiguous: join alone with no shared action supplied
plans or proposed cooperation without realization
unclear cooperative versus adversarial action
predicates.notes: A narrow joint-action meaning, not a generic association. With truncated join-only paths and no action context, use A rather than assuming what the entities did together.

predicates.label: commented on
predicates.definition: Entity X made an explicit statement or comment about entity Y.
includes: say-of, comment-on, or a statement explicitly referring to Y
explicit praise, criticism, or accusation about Y
historical attributed statements
excludes: speaking to Y without establishing that Y is the subject
ordinary interaction or comparison without a statement by X
a statement about someone else related to Y
ambiguous: unclear speaker or subject attachment
a quotation or reference without an identifiable statement about Y
predicates.notes: The argument Y is the topic, not necessarily the addressee. This is distinct from communicates_to; do not infer an evaluation or sentiment merely from comment.

predicates.label: trailed sporting competitor
predicates.definition: Sporting competitor X was behind competitor Y in a game score or competitive standings.
includes: explicit trail or games-behind
explicit lower score or standings position relative to Y
historical in-game or season standings
excludes: a completed defeat without evidence of trailing during play or in standings
political or commercial ranking
ordinary following or geographic movement
X leading or ahead of Y
ambiguous: a generic behind phrase without competitive context
unclear ordered competitor roles
a proposed or hypothetical score situation
predicates.notes: Trailing is an intermediate state and does not imply the final winner. The direction is trailing competitor to leading competitor.

predicates.label: politically controlled by
predicates.definition: Political institution, legislature, government, or geographic territory X is or was politically controlled by group or government Y.
includes: explicit political control, takeover, or governing majority by Y
historical control including clearly established loss of prior control
excludes: an ordinary member or individual officeholder without group control
corporate ownership
political support or influence alone
proposed takeover without realization
ambiguous: generic have, take, or govern without clear control context
unclear political body or group identity
control versus ordinary office unresolved
predicates.notes: Inverse of politically_controls. A mere member of a legislature does not establish party control.

predicates.label: organization operates in industry or domain
predicates.definition: Organization X is explicitly described as operating in industry, business field, or technological domain Y.
includes: explicit industry or domain modifier of company, agency, or business
stated operations or business activity in Y
historical business-domain identity
excludes: nationality or geographic location
corporate parent or corporate family name
a passing reference to users, data, or an unrelated product without business-domain evidence
a person working in a field
ambiguous: a nominal modifier that could mean owner, place, or industry
unclear organization versus personal referent
generic Internet mention without a business-domain role
predicates.notes: A business-field classification, not geographic location and not a generic association with the domain.

predicates.label: succeeded person in role
predicates.definition: Person X took over a role previously held by person Y.
includes: explicit succession or replacement in an office or professional role
historical successor taking office
clearly established temporary or acting replacement
excludes: X appointed a third person to replace Y
generic opposition, criticism, or substitution unrelated to a role
a proposed successor without established tenure
ambiguous: bare replace where appointing versus taking over is unresolved
unclear predecessor or role
candidate or announced future replacement without tenure
predicates.notes: Direction is successor to predecessor. It does not imply that X and Y are the same person or held office simultaneously.

predicates.label: played at sporting venue
predicates.definition: Sporting competitor or team X played a game or competition at venue Y.
includes: explicit play-at or game-at with X as competitor
a completed win or loss at Y establishing competitive play there
historical sporting venue use
excludes: ordinary attendance, practice, or employment at a place
plans without established play
the opponent or event substituted for the venue
ambiguous: future scheduled play without realization
unclear competitor versus spectator role
a generic at-venue phrase without a game context
predicates.notes: Narrower than physical presence. It does not assert that Y is the permanent home stadium.

predicates.label: has lawyer or legal counsel
predicates.definition: Client or institutional principal X is represented by or professionally affiliated with lawyer, attorney, or legal counsel Y.
includes: explicit lawyer, attorney, or counsel for X
historical legal representation or institutional legal office
public attorney for the named jurisdiction
excludes: ordinary spokesperson, adviser, or employee without a legal role
a place where a lawyer practices without client or institutional affiliation
a third party lawyer merely quoted about X
ambiguous: unclear legal client versus geographic location
lawyer title attachment unresolved
an incomplete principal
predicates.notes: Inverse of lawyer_for. This does not require that the legal professional exclusively represents X.

predicates.label: broadcasts or carries program
predicates.definition: Broadcaster X is explicitly identified as broadcasting, carrying, or having program Y in its programming.
includes: explicit airing or broadcasting of Y
Y identified as the program or show of broadcaster X
historical programming affiliation
excludes: ownership of a network or production company alone
an ordinary press interaction or meeting
a person appearing on a program without broadcaster-program identification
ambiguous: an incomplete program title such as Press with unresolved referent
unclear broadcaster versus guest role
program versus generic activity attachment unresolved
predicates.notes: Programming affiliation does not imply ownership or production. Embedded title verbs such as Meet must not be interpreted as an ordinary interpersonal meeting.

predicates.label: official of institution
predicates.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified official role in institution or governmental body Y.
includes: explicit official-of, official-at, or institutional official description
historical official role
a named formal public office that unambiguously entails official status
excludes: ordinary employment without an official role
a city dateline or institution standing in the person slot
a generic adviser or spokesperson without official status
proposed appointment alone
ambiguous: unclear person versus place identity
official title attachment unresolved
a generic institutional role without established official status
predicates.notes: Separate from managerial_office_in: an official need not be a manager. Do not infer official status from every professional affiliation.

predicates.label: unresolved relation meaning
predicates.definition: The complete relation dictionary and argument roles do not identify a coherent dominant predicate whose facts can be judged without inventing a scope.
includes: explicitly documented relation-level semantic indeterminacy after complete dictionary and argument-role inspection
excludes: using ambiguity to omit difficult facts or change denominators
a broad association or disjunction invented to make unrelated meanings correct
using this marker when a coherent dominant family can be identified
ambiguous: all facts remain ambiguous because the relation meaning is unresolved
predicates.notes: This is an evaluation marker, not a learned semantic relation. Every fact receives A with a case-specific question; retain all facts in denominators and separately report relation-semantic-indeterminacy counts.

predicates.label: has minister
predicates.definition: Country, government, or political administration X has or had person Y as an explicitly identified minister.
includes: explicit minister of X or X's minister
a portfolio or prime minister office explicitly attached to X
historical ministerial office
excludes: ordinary official, ambassador, or opposition politician without minister title
a minister of a different government merely meeting X
candidate or proposed appointment alone
ambiguous: an incomplete national adjective in the institution slot
minister-designate without established tenure
unclear portfolio or government attachment
predicates.notes: The inverse ministerial office does not assert that every minister is the head of government.

predicates.label: fought military conflict against
predicates.definition: Political entity or military group X fought an armed conflict or war against Y.
includes: explicit war-with or fought-against in an armed-conflict context
actual military attack or combat against Y
historical military adversaries
excludes: sports competition or metaphorical political attack
cooperation, alliance, or joint action on the same side
border adjacency or diplomatic relations alone
planned conflict without realization
ambiguous: fight-with whose allied versus adversarial sense is unresolved
generic attack without military context
future threat or proposed war
predicates.notes: Military adversarial conflict is distinct from cooperation and from criticizing. The predicate does not imply a winner.

predicates.label: supports or endorses
predicates.definition: Entity X explicitly gives political, material, or institutional support or endorsement to Y.
includes: explicit supports, backs, endorses, or provides identified aid to Y
voting for Y as an endorsement
historical support
excludes: merely pressuring or criticizing Y
ordinary alliance or meeting without support assertion
generic possession or acquisition
physical support of an object unrelated to the institutional relation
ambiguous: give with omitted object
unclear support versus pressure or opposition
a future proposed endorsement without realization
predicates.notes: This does not imply permanent agreement or exclusive support. A bare give edge is insufficient without an identified supportive act or other local evidence.

predicates.label: outnumbers
predicates.definition: Group X has a larger number of members or counted units than group Y in an explicitly stated context.
includes: explicit outnumber relation
a stated numerical comparison establishing a larger count
historical counts in a particular population
excludes: electoral victory or political control without numerical comparison
generic superiority or strength
score or performance comparison not counting group members
ambiguous: unclear counted population or ordered groups
a truncated comparison that omits what is counted
predicates.notes: This concerns a stated population and time; it does not imply universal or permanent numerical superiority.

predicates.label: legal specialist in field
predicates.definition: Person X is explicitly identified as a legal expert or lawyer specializing in legal field or issue Y.
includes: lawyer specializing in Y
explicit legal expert, authority, or specialist on Y
a legal-field modifier of a lawyer
excludes: client representation without specialization
generic institutional membership
practice location or ordinary employment
expertise in a nonlegal field
ambiguous: unclear legal field versus client
lawyer title or field attachment unresolved
predicates.notes: Y is a legal subject, not the represented client. Expertise is textual attribution, not an independent credential evaluation.

predicates.label: broadcasts event
predicates.definition: Broadcaster X broadcasts or broadcast coverage of event Y.
includes: explicit broadcast or telecast of Y
a stated event show on X
historical event coverage
excludes: broadcasting another program after Y
rights ownership alone without actual coverage
advertisement placement or rejection alone
ordinary attendance or commentary about Y
ambiguous: announced future coverage or rights without realization
unclear broadcaster versus production role
generic have or show without event-coverage attachment
predicates.notes: Separate from broadcasts_program for a named regular program; no ownership or exclusive-rights claim is implied.

predicates.label: event held in place
predicates.definition: Event X takes or took place in geographic location Y.
includes: explicit event held-in or occurring-in Y
an event actually brought to or taking place in Y
historical event location
excludes: a team's organizational location or ordinary person travel
attendance originating from Y
a place merely bidding or competing to host X
discussion of an event in a publication
ambiguous: proposed, hoped-for, or future hosting without realization
generic have/bring/lure with missing modality
place versus institution or event identity unresolved
predicates.notes: This requires event occurrence at the location, not only a bid or planned destination.

predicates.label: sells to
predicates.definition: Entity X sells or sold goods, services, property, or transferable rights to buyer Y.
includes: explicit sell-to or sale-to
a completed commercial transfer to Y
historical sales including transferable sporting contracts
excludes: ordinary giving or physical movement
a proposed sale without realization
Y is the item sold rather than the buyer
ambiguous: unclear seller-versus-item role
proposed or conditional sale
a nominal sale whose owner or seller is unresolved
predicates.notes: An explicit sell-to edge can establish the commercial relation without identifying the item; generic give/send does not.

predicates.label: has athlete on team
predicates.definition: Team or sporting organization X has or had person Y as a player or competing athlete.
includes: explicit player or athlete on X
X fields or plays Y as an athlete
a stated playing membership in X
excludes: coach or manager alone
wanting or needing Y without roster membership
an opponent rather than a team member
ordinary possession or a book title
ambiguous: generic have without athlete-role context
proposed recruitment without established membership
unclear team or player identity
predicates.notes: Inverse of athlete_for. A team needing a person does not prove that the person plays for it.

predicates.label: researches or analyzes topic
predicates.definition: Person or organization X explicitly researches, studies, tracks, or analyzes subject or field Y.
includes: explicit research or study of Y
tracking trends or analyzing developments in Y
producing identified analytical research or reports on Y
excludes: ordinary business operation in a field without research activity
a passing reference or generic Internet use
selling another producer's reports without analysis
institutional employment alone
ambiguous: report authorship or analytical role unresolved
unclear topic versus employer
mere report distribution without identified research
predicates.notes: Y is the subject of inquiry, not necessarily the employer. This does not evaluate the quality or truth of the research.

predicates.label: entered agreement with
predicates.definition: Entity X entered or had an explicit agreement with counterpart Y.
includes: explicit agreement-with
a stated shared agreement or accord
historical agreement
excludes: mere meeting or conversation
unilateral approval or support without shared agreement
a proposed agreement or ongoing negotiation without realization
ambiguous: unclear parties to an agreement
a future or conditional agreement
approval by a subunit without evidence of agreement by Y
predicates.notes: A specific agreement is sufficient; this does not imply agreement on every issue or permanent alliance.

predicates.label: has diplomatic relations with
predicates.definition: Country or government X maintains or maintained diplomatic relations with country or government Y.
includes: explicit diplomatic relations
an ambassador of X accredited to Y
historical diplomatic relations
excludes: ordinary trade, physical travel, or war alone
generic political or personal association
an ambassador merely visiting Y without accreditation
proposed relations without establishment
ambiguous: generic relationship or relation without diplomatic context
unclear government versus private entity
unclear ambassador accreditation or country attachment
predicates.notes: Diplomatic relations do not imply alliance, friendship, or agreement on policy.

predicates.label: adviser to principal
predicates.definition: Person X explicitly serves or served as an adviser or counselor to principal Y.
includes: explicit adviser/advisor-to or possessive adviser role
an identified counselor providing advisory service
historical advisory role
excludes: director, lawyer, or formal leadership title alone
ordinary communication or acquaintance
confidant alone without advisory service
expertise on a topic rather than advice to a principal
ambiguous: an omitted or materially incomplete principal
counselor versus legal counsel attachment unresolved
advisory topic substituted for principal
predicates.notes: The principal may be a person or institution. Advice does not imply formal management or spokesperson authority.

predicates.label: flows into waterbody
predicates.definition: River or watercourse X flows into, joins, or empties into receiving waterbody Y.
includes: explicit flow-into or empty-into
river confluence with an identified receiving waterbody
river meeting Y when direction is locally clear
excludes: ordinary interpersonal meeting or joint action
adjacency or a waterfront gateway alone
flow in the reverse direction
ambiguous: a bare meet or join with unresolved receiving direction
unclear watercourse versus place name
predicates.notes: Direction is upstream tributary or river to receiving waterbody; confluence alone must identify direction locally.

predicates.label: dismissed person from role
predicates.definition: Person or institution X fired or dismissed person Y from a professional or official role.
includes: explicit firing or dismissal
clearly terminating Y's role
historical dismissal
excludes: criticizing or blaming alone
X taking Y's role without evidence of dismissing Y
ordinary departure or voluntary resignation
dismissing an argument rather than a person from a role
ambiguous: replace where removal versus succession is unresolved
a proposed firing without realization
unclear actor or dismissed person
predicates.notes: The dismissing actor need not become the successor. This is separate from succeeded_person.

predicates.label: strategist for institution
predicates.definition: Person X explicitly serves or served as a strategist for institution or principal Y.
includes: explicit strategist-at, strategist-for, or institutional strategist role
historical strategy office
excludes: analyst or ordinary adviser alone
a comparison or strategy topic without affiliation
ordinary employment without strategist role
ambiguous: unclear principal versus topic
strategist title attachment unresolved
predicates.notes: A distinct occupational role; do not merge every analyst or adviser into it.

predicates.label: confers authority on institution
predicates.definition: Legal instrument or governing document X explicitly grants authority, powers, rights, or an institutional mandate to Y.
includes: an identified power or authority granted to Y
explicit rights or mandate conferred under X
historical textual allocation of authority
excludes: ordinary transfer of physical goods or sporting contribution
mentioning institutional requirements without granting authority
general association with a legal text
ambiguous: give or grant with omitted object
under-X have with no identified power
a provision whose grant or recipient is unresolved
predicates.notes: This labels what the supplied text asserts, not a legal determination. Generic gives does not recover an omitted legal power.

predicates.label: has policy towards
predicates.definition: Government or institution X has an explicitly identified policy directed toward entity Y.
includes: explicit X policy-toward Y
an identified institutional policy concerning Y
historical policy target
excludes: trade, travel, armed conflict, or ordinary relations without a policy assertion
an individual statement without institutional policy attribution
generic support or opposition alone
ambiguous: unclear policy owner or target
a proposed policy without establishment
a topic or population substituted for an unresolved entity
predicates.notes: This identifies the policy target only; it does not assert a favorable stance, diplomatic relations, or policy effectiveness.

predicates.label: population includes subgroup members
predicates.definition: Population X is explicitly described as including people of demographic subgroup Y.
includes: explicit population including people from Y
a stated subgroup among the described population
historical described populations
excludes: ordinary organizational membership or corporate ownership
geographic containment alone
mere comparison, proximity, or interaction
inferring that every member of Y belongs to X
ambiguous: generic include with unclear demographic roles
unclear population versus person or organization
a subgroup attachment to another population
predicates.notes: This asserts textual inclusion of subgroup members in the population being discussed, not universal set containment Y subset X.

predicates.label: calls up players from team
predicates.definition: Sports team X calls up, promotes, recalls, or summons players from source team or affiliate Y.
includes: explicit promotion or recall from a source team
calling or summoning a player from Y into X
clear team-to-affiliate recall or promotion context even if the player's name is omitted
excludes: ordinary travel or communication from a geographic place
corporate ownership alone
sending a player in the opposite direction
a proposed promotion without realization
ambiguous: the omitted object could be something other than a player
unclear source versus destination team
bare call-from without recruitment context
predicates.notes: The direction is receiving team to source team. It does not require ownership of the affiliate or imply that all its players move.

predicates.label: dancer for company
predicates.definition: Person X dances or danced professionally for dance company or producing ensemble Y.
includes: explicit dancer in or for Y
principal dancer role in Y
performing for Y when the local dancer role is established
excludes: directing or management alone
generic performing without dance context
staging a work or being on payroll alone
a venue without company affiliation
ambiguous: principal title without clear dancer meaning
unclear dancer versus director attachment
company versus venue identity unresolved
predicates.notes: A specific artistic occupation, distinct from general institutional membership or management.

predicates.label: political or military ally of
predicates.definition: Political entity X is or was an explicitly identified political or military ally of Y.
includes: explicit ally-of or possessive ally relation
historical political or military alliance
excludes: a generic relationship or agreement alone
cooperation, trade, communication, or shared interests without alliance
travel or emigration between countries
ambiguous: an unspecified relationship without explicit alliance
unclear holder or direction of the ally description
predicates.notes: Alliance is separate from acting jointly on one occasion or maintaining diplomatic relations. Declaration must identify the explicit ally family rather than absorb generic international associations.

predicates.label: fielded or used an athlete in play
predicates.definition: Team, coach, or manager X fields or uses athlete Y in sporting play.
includes: explicit playing or fielding of an individual athlete by a team or coach
historical use of the athlete in play
excludes: playing against an opposing team or competitor
mere player membership without X selecting or using the athlete
ordinary employment or political candidacy
ambiguous: generic removal without a clear sporting selection context
play whose athlete-versus-opponent role is unresolved
prospective selection or materially incomplete action roles
predicates.notes: The subject can be the coach rather than the team. Bare play is polysemous; inspect both arguments and all local evidence. Removing an athlete does not by itself establish that X fielded the athlete.

predicates.label: lobbyist for principal
predicates.definition: Person or organization X holds or held an explicitly identified lobbying role for principal Y.
includes: explicit lobbyist for or of Y
historical lobbying service for Y
excludes: director of legislation or another managerial title without a lobbying role
ordinary advocacy, communication, legal service, or political agreement alone
membership in the principal organization alone
ambiguous: unclear lobbying principal or title attachment
incomplete institution or personal principal
predicates.notes: Legislative directorship and lobbying can coexist but are distinct roles. The definition does not infer lobbying from a legislative director title.

predicates.label: transferred territory to
predicates.definition: Political authority X transferred territorial control or sovereignty to authority Y.
includes: explicit return of territory to Y
handover with a resolved territorial object and recipient
historical territorial transfer
excludes: ordinary travel or a person returning to a place
generic ownership, defeat, or geographic proximity
a proposed transfer without realization
ambiguous: generic return or handover with no resolved territorial object
unclear transfer direction or recipient
prospective or hypothetical handover
predicates.notes: The transferred territory is an omitted third role and must be established by local evidence; do not supply it from historical knowledge.

predicates.label: publisher of publication
predicates.definition: Person or organization X holds or held the publisher role for publication Y, or explicitly publishes Y.
includes: explicit publisher-of title
explicit publication of the identified newspaper, journal, book, or other work
historical publisher role
excludes: editor, writer, owner, developer, or director alone
travel to a publisher or publication office
a work merely mentioning or reviewing Y
ambiguous: incomplete publication title
unclear publisher-versus-author or title attachment
predicates.notes: Publisher is distinct from editor and from ownership. Co-occurring ownership does not replace the requirement for publication or an explicit publisher role.

predicates.label: political candidate or nominee for party
predicates.definition: Person X is or was an explicitly identified candidate, contender for nomination, or nominee of political party Y.
includes: explicit party candidate or nominee
front-runner or contender for the party nomination
historical candidacy or nomination
excludes: holding an executive or other office without party candidacy
merely supporting or belonging to the party
candidacy for a corporate or sporting appointment
ambiguous: a constituency or office appears where the political party is omitted
candidate or nomination attachment does not identify whose party nomination is sought
the purported party is materially truncated or unidentified
predicates.notes: This is a candidacy relation and does not claim election or actual office. The second role is the political party, not the office being contested. Republican as an identified party label follows the inherited party-label convention.

predicates.label: advances legislative measures through body
predicates.definition: Political actor X advances a legislative measure through legislative body Y.
includes: explicit pushing or advancing legislation through Y
historical legislative action
excludes: gaining control of or taking over the body
ordinary membership, lobbying or communication without advancing a measure
physical movement through a building
ambiguous: push-through with the legislative object omitted
unclear proposer or legislative body
prospective intent without established action
predicates.notes: The legislation is a third role and must be locally recoverable; bare push-through does not identify the measure or guarantee passage.

predicates.label: belongs to named corporate family
predicates.definition: Company X is explicitly described as belonging to the named corporate family or historical corporate lineage Y.
includes: explicit named-family company descriptors such as Bell company
explicit membership in a group of successor companies identified by that corporate lineage
historical corporate-family identification
excludes: current parent ownership without a family or lineage assertion
ordinary alliance, commercial cooperation or generic association
a company in an industry or geographic place
ambiguous: unclear corporate family designation or nominal attachment
a person or incomplete company name replacing the company argument
predicates.notes: A corporate-family label is distinct from ownership by a current legal parent. This category does not infer that all family companies are owned by an entity called Y.

predicates.label: killed by perpetrator
predicates.definition: Person X or explicitly affected members of population X were killed by perpetrator Y or explicitly identified agents of Y.
includes: explicit killed-by or murder-by with correct victim and perpetrator roles
explicit killing by the named authority soldiers or troops
historical killing of identified members of a population
excludes: geographic death-place
occupation or hostility alone
shooting or injury without established death
a population assertion interpreted as death of every member
ambiguous: unclear victim or perpetrator attachment
unresolved identity of troops or agents
shooting where fatal outcome is unspecified
predicates.notes: This direction is victim to perpetrator. The evaluation concerns textual support only; it does not independently adjudicate historical responsibility.

predicates.label: reviews works in medium
predicates.definition: Person X critically reviews artistic works or editions presented in medium Y.
includes: explicit review of a collection, edition or version identified by the medium
historical critical review in the identified medium
excludes: review of a performer or venue alone
the publication carrying the review rather than the medium of the reviewed work
merely mentioning or producing the medium
ambiguous: unclear whether Y identifies the reviewed-work medium or the review publication
missing critic or review attachment
predicates.notes: This is a distinct argument relation from reviews_artistic_output_of. A DVD collection review can establish the medium even if the work title is omitted.

predicates.label: trades athletes to team
predicates.definition: Sports team X transfers an athlete to team Y through a sporting player trade.
includes: explicit team-to-team player trade
historical athlete transfer by trade
excludes: playing against the other team
ordinary trade of goods or territorial transfer
a player joining a team without an identified trading team
mere proposal or interest without a trade
ambiguous: trade-to with omitted object and unresolved athlete-transfer context
unclear sending versus receiving team
trade talks or future proposal without realization
predicates.notes: The athlete is a third role. Clear team-to-team player-trade context can establish the action without naming the player; otherwise retain the omitted-object uncertainty.

predicates.label: has political candidate or nominee
predicates.definition: Political party X has or had person Y as an explicitly identified candidate, contender for its nomination, or nominee.
includes: explicit party nominee or candidate
explicit contender for the party nomination
historical candidacy
excludes: holding political office without candidacy
ordinary membership or an opposing-party rival
a corporate or sporting appointment
ambiguous: an unspecified challenger or hopeful without identified party candidacy
a constituency or office replacing the party
an unnamed or materially truncated person or party
predicates.notes: This is the exact inverse of candidate_for and does not claim winning election or holding office. Republican as an identified party label follows the inherited party-label convention.

predicates.label: research fellow at institution
predicates.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified research, academic, or policy fellowship at institution Y.

historical fellowship

a colleague described merely as fellow person
institutional employment alone
ambiguous: unclear fellowship title or institutional attachment
honorific membership versus a research fellowship when unresolved
predicates.notes: This is a specific fellowship role; nearby scholar or economist roles may coexist but do not establish it alone.

predicates.label: ethicist at institution
predicates.definition: Person X works or worked as an explicitly identified ethicist or bioethicist affiliated with institution Y.

historical ethics professional affiliation

generic discussion of ethics
being an ethical person rather than a professional ethicist
ambiguous: unclear role or institutional attachment
a specialty subject replacing the employing or affiliated institution
predicates.notes: Bioethics is a specific field within professional ethics. The relation does not evaluate the truth of ethical claims or infer an ethicist title from another academic office.

predicates.label: institutional officer of
predicates.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified professional officer role in institution Y.
includes: explicit officer of/with/at institutional role
historical institutional officership
excludes: ordinary employment or membership without an officer title
researcher, observer, analyst or director alone
inferring executive rank or governmental authority from the word officer
ambiguous: unclear officer title or institutional attachment
a personal principal or topic replacing the institution
predicates.notes: This specific officer title is distinct from executive_of and official_of. It does not assert senior management or a government office.

predicates.label: expelled or deported
predicates.definition: Authority or acting group X forcibly expelled or deported person Y or explicitly affected members of population Y.
includes: explicit expulsion or deportation by X of Y
historical forced removal of identified members of a population
excludes: barring entry without removal
ordinary voluntary departure
killing, occupation or criticism alone
assuming every member of a named population was expelled
ambiguous: unclear expelling authority or affected people
proposed expulsion without established action
leaving under pressure without an explicit expulsion or deportation
predicates.notes: Direction is expelling authority to affected person/population. The source territory is a separate omitted role; this does not identify a destination.

predicates.label: secretary to principal

includes: explicit secretary-to or possessive secretary title for a named person or institution
historical secretarial office

ordinary communication or employment without secretary title
inferring leadership or a specific cabinet portfolio from secretary alone
ambiguous: unclear secretary or principal attachment
an omitted department or principal when the role cannot be resolved
predicates.notes: This specific secretary role is separate from general advice, speaking for a principal, and organizational leadership.

predicates.label: promotes ideology of

generic support of Y without ideology advocacy
ordinary communication or opposition
ambiguous: unclear advocate or ideology source attachment
